import gdb, json, time
live = {}
sites = []
allocated = 0
freed = 0
snapshots = 0
failures = []
exit_code = None
selected = {8192, 20480}
sizes = set(selected)
def fail(message):
    failures.append(message)
    raise gdb.GdbError(message)
def filters():
    free_bp.condition = " || ".join("$rsi == %d" % s for s in sorted(sizes))
    resize_bp.condition = "(" + free_bp.condition + ") || " + " || ".join("$rcx == %d" % s for s in sorted(selected))
pending = {}
return_calls = 0
def Returned(owner, old=None):
    global return_calls
    return_calls += 1
    if return_calls > 16384 or len(pending) >= 128:
        fail("return tracking quota exceeded")
    ident = return_calls
    sp = int(gdb.parse_and_eval("$rsp"))
    address = int(gdb.parse_and_eval("*(unsigned long long*)$rsp"))
    bp = gdb.Breakpoint("*%d" % address, internal=True)
    bp.thread = gdb.selected_thread().global_num
    bp.condition = "$rsp == %d" % (sp + 8)
    pending[ident] = (bp, owner, old)
    bp.commands = "silent\npython returned(%d)\ncontinue\n" % ident
def returned(ident):
    bp, owner, old = pending.pop(ident)
    bp.delete()
    address = int(gdb.parse_and_eval("$rax"))
    if not address:
        fail("allocation or resize failed; old owner retained")
    if old is not None:
        live.pop(old, None)
    if address in live:
        fail("duplicate live allocation address")
    live[address] = owner
def stack_site():
    frames = []
    frame = gdb.newest_frame()
    for _ in range(24):
        if frame is None:
            break
        frames.append((frame.name() or "?")[:240])
        frame = frame.older()
    if frames not in sites:
        if len(sites) >= 64:
            fail("site quota exceeded")
        sites.append(frames)
        print("SITE", json.dumps({"id": len(sites), "frames": frames}))
    return sites.index(frames) + 1
def new_owner(size):
    global allocated
    allocated += 1
    if allocated > 4096:
        fail("allocation quota exceeded")
    return (allocated, size, stack_site())
def allocate():
    size = int(gdb.parse_and_eval("$rdi"))
    if size not in selected:
        fail("allocation filter mismatch")
    Returned(new_owner(size))
def deallocate():
    global freed
    address = int(gdb.parse_and_eval("$rdi"))
    if address in live:
        freed += 1
        live.pop(address)
def resize():
    address = int(gdb.parse_and_eval("$rdi"))
    size = int(gdb.parse_and_eval("$rcx"))
    if address in live:
        ident, _, site = live[address]
        if size not in sizes:
            sizes.add(size)
            filters()
        Returned((ident, size, site), address)
    elif size in selected:
        Returned(new_owner(size))
def checkpoint():
    global snapshots
    snapshots += 1
    print("CHECKPOINT", json.dumps({"index": snapshots, "unix_millis": int(time.time()*1000), "live": sorted(live.values())}))
for symbol in ("__rust_alloc", "__rust_alloc_zeroed"):
    bp = gdb.Breakpoint("*'__rustc::" + symbol + "'", internal=True)
    bp.condition = " || ".join("$rdi == %d" % s for s in sorted(selected))
    bp.commands = "silent\npython allocate()\ncontinue\n"
free_bp = gdb.Breakpoint("*'__rustc::__rust_dealloc'", internal=True)
free_bp.commands = "silent\npython deallocate()\ncontinue\n"
resize_bp = gdb.Breakpoint("*'__rustc::__rust_realloc'", internal=True)
resize_bp.commands = "silent\npython resize()\ncontinue\n"
filters()
for symbol in ("tun_namespace::allocation_sample::emit", "tun_namespace::allocation_sample::emit_sizes"):
    bp = gdb.Breakpoint(symbol, internal=True)
    bp.commands = "silent\npython checkpoint()\ncontinue\n"
print("TRACE_READY", json.dumps({"pid": gdb.selected_inferior().pid, "unix_millis": int(time.time()*1000)}))
def ended(event):
    global exit_code
    exit_code = getattr(event, "exit_code", None)
    print("TRACE_SUMMARY", json.dumps({"allocated": allocated, "freed": freed, "live": sorted(live.values()), "snapshots": snapshots, "sites": len(sites), "failures": failures, "exit_code": exit_code, "pending_returns": len(pending), "return_calls": return_calls}))
gdb.events.exited.connect(ended)

end
continue
